# Lulox (Luciano Oliva Bianco)

> Luciano Oliva Bianco ("Lulox") automates teams' repetitive work with AI agents and n8n, and builds custom CRMs and internal tools. He works remotely from Argentina, in Spanish or English. Site in Spanish at the root and in English under /en.

Automatizo con agentes de IA y n8n el trabajo repetitivo de tu equipo, y armo CRMs y sistemas a medida. Si hoy eso lo hacen personas, a mano, una y otra vez, lo pasamos a un flujo que lo hace solo.

## Services

- [Servicios / Services](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios): automation with AI agents, n8n workflows, custom CRM, custom internal tools. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services
- [Contratar / Hire](https://lulox.com.ar/contratar): price calculator (rough quote in seconds) and contact form. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/hire
- How it works: 1) you describe what your team does by hand, 2) a call and a rough estimate, 3) 50% upfront and 50% on delivery.

## Examples of what can be automated (examples, not client work)

- Email: sort incoming mail, draft repeated replies, alert when something urgent arrives.
- Moving data: from spreadsheets, forms or email into a CRM, a calendar or a sheet, without copying by hand.
- Receipts, invoices and reports: extract the data from a photo or a file and load it, instead of typing it every time.

## Things he has built

- [Garpen](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/garpen): personal ERP with contacts (CRM), agenda, finances and a billable timer. Live: https://garpen.lulox.com.ar
- [Tarask](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/tarask): personal finance with shared households, AI receipts and summaries. Live: https://tarask.lulox.com.ar
- [Malito](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/malito): self-hosted email inbox with contacts synced to Garpen. Live: https://malito.lulox.com.ar
- [All projects](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos)
